# @ifcopenshell/util

IfcOpenShell utility functions for JavaScript and TypeScript, transpiled from
the Python `ifcopenshell.util` package. Each Python module is one import path:

```ts
import * as ifcopenshell from 'ifcopenshell';
import { getProjectUnit, getUnitScale } from '@ifcopenshell/util/unit';

await ifcopenshell.init();
const model = ifcopenshell.open(bytes);
const length = getProjectUnit(model, 'LENGTHUNIT');
```

Function names are camelCase. Required Python parameters stay positional and
optional ones go into a trailing options object, so
`get_project_unit(f, "LENGTHUNIT", use_cache=True)` becomes
`getProjectUnit(f, 'LENGTHUNIT', { useCache: true })`.

`src/` is generated by `src/transpiler/generate.py` (`npm run generate`) and is
not committed. The hand-written runtime it relies on (Python semantics, numpy,
datetime, ...) lives in `runtime/` and is copied into `src/` by the generator.
`transpile.json`, also generated, lists each module's untranslated functions,
which throw when called. Behaviour is checked against Python by `src/ts/ifcopenshell-parity`.
